author: Sega Jenesis
title: Looking for digital artists for custom Pokémon binder scenes
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway! Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚 If you’re an artist or know someone who might be interested, please send them my way! I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability. 🥰 Contact via Threads replies.

title: Paid EP cover artwork opportunity
content: Hello! Paid project opportunity for visual artists 👇 I’m looking for a visual artist to create the cover artwork for my very first EP. Looking for: digital illustration inspired by Magritte’s surrealist and dreamlike aesthetic. (A detailed brief will be shared with shortlisted artists.) If you’re interested, feel free to reach out via Instagram DM or email(itssmosko@gmail.com) and share your portfolio so I can have a look at your work. Looking forward to discovering your creative worlds! Smosko
